scope: Primary-source search for independent long-horizon LFP/graphite calendar-aging evidence

qualification_summary.binding_blocker: No dataset found that simultaneously has explicit reusable data rights, independent physical-cell trajectories, LFP/graphite chemistry, separable calendar aging, at least 730 days, and an unexposed confirmatory outcome partition.

evidence_tiers.D0_ineligible_or_blocked: Cannot currently be scored under the independent protocol.
evidence_tiers.D1_auxiliary_stress_or_field: Useful for stress, rejection, or operational diagnostics, but not long-term calendar confirmation.
evidence_tiers.D2_long_horizon_endpoint: Can test a long-horizon endpoint only; cannot confirm a dynamic landmark or trajectory.
evidence_tiers.D3_long_horizon_trajectory_retrospective: Can support a locked retrospective trajectory replication, not outcome-blind confirmation.
evidence_tiers.D4_locked_external_trajectory: Protocol and predictions were frozen before project-level outcome access.
evidence_tiers.D5_prospective_operational: Outcomes were generated after freeze and operational issuance gates passed.

datasets.title: Data for: Analysis and modeling of calendar aging of a commercial LiFePO4/graphite cell
datasets.grain: 17 temperature-SOC test points with three physical cells per point in the source study; the released evaluation files are grouped by test point and repository metadata do not establish a reusable physical-cell identifier field.
datasets.recommended_action: Retain as development evidence only; never relabel it as independent confirmation.

datasets.title: Experimental Calendar Ageing Data for Lithium-Ion Battery Chemistries
datasets.duration_note: Checkups at 0, 39, 59, 84, and 120 days for the LFP subset.
datasets.grain: 15 physical LFP cells at 60 C across 20%, 50%, and 100% SOC.
datasets.recommended_action: Keep the negative-transfer result as an accelerated external stress check only.

datasets.title: Stanford Long Term Calendar Aging Dataset
datasets.duration_note: Up to 13 years across 232 commercial cells and eight cell types; an LFP subset is present.
datasets.chemistry: mixed commercial chemistries including LFP; per-cell anode chemistry must be confirmed before eligibility
datasets.grain: Per-cell raw and summary JSON files with a published cell-ID crosswalk.
datasets.recommended_action: Wait for written data and code permission. If granted, freeze a dataset-specific protocol and run only a locked retrospective replication; do not claim outcome-blind confirmation.

datasets.title: Shelf life of lithium-ion batteries: Recommissioning LiFePO4/C cells after ten years of uninterrupted calendar aging
datasets.duration_note: Ten uninterrupted years at 6 degrees Celsius and 50% SOC, followed by endpoint characterization.
datasets.grain: 100 physical cells; publication reports 96%-98% retained capacity, but no intermediate checkups exist during uninterrupted storage.
datasets.recommended_action: Request individual BOL and ten-year endpoint values plus explicit reuse permission. Use only as a decade endpoint check, never as dynamic-landmark confirmation.

datasets.title: The Degradation Behavior of LiFePO4/C Batteries during Long-Term Calendar Aging
datasets.duration_note: 43 months for three cases and 27 months for two cases, with approximately monthly reference tests.
datasets.grain: 15 physical cells, five conditions, three cells per condition; article analysis emphasizes median curves and variability summaries.
datasets.recommended_action: Ask the authors for the monthly individual-cell capacity table and explicit research/competition reuse terms.

datasets.title: Degradation modes of large-format stationary-storage LFP-based lithium-ion cells during calendaric and cyclic aging
datasets.duration_note: Approximately 850 days of calendar aging at 35 C or 50 C and 75% or 100% SOC.
datasets.grain: Large-format individual cells; exact reusable cell-level table and replicate support are not publicly deposited.
datasets.recommended_action: High-priority author request because the 180 Ah stationary-storage form factor is the closest domain match.

datasets.title: Aging behavior of LiFePO4-based battery cells at stack level: A Second-Life cycling study
datasets.duration_note: More than 14 years total cell age, including seven years of measured Second-Life use and up to 9600 cycles.
datasets.chemistry: 100 Ah LiFePO4-based cells; graphite anode is not established as a reusable eligibility field
datasets.grain: Nine selected physical cells with long cycling trajectories; First-Life voltage, current, capacity, and temperature histories were not recorded.
datasets.recommended_action: Request data only for mixed-aging transfer and rejection diagnostics, not calendar confirmation.

datasets.title: Data for: Multi-year field measurements of home storage systems and their use in capacity estimation
datasets.duration_note: Up to eight years, 106 system-years total.
datasets.chemistry: system cohort includes LFP, NMC, and LMO-NMC blend; chemistry is not a uniform LFP/graphite cohort
datasets.grain: 21 home-storage system IDs with one-second pack-level measurements and periodic field capacity tests; no individual physical-cell trajectories.
datasets.recommended_action: Potential later system-level operational plausibility study; do not use to confirm cell-level calendar landmarks.

datasets.title: Lithium-Ion Battery Field Data: 28 LFP battery systems with 8 cells in series, up to 5 years of operation
datasets.duration_note: One month to five years depending on system.
datasets.chemistry: LFP systems; anode composition is anonymized/not established in repository metadata
datasets.grain: 28 system IDs and 224 cell-voltage channels; only pack current is measured and individual-cell capacity/SOH labels are absent.
datasets.recommended_action: Useful for future route rejection, fault, and field-shift diagnostics under non-commercial terms only.

datasets.title: WMG Calendar Ageing Dataset - LGM50 Commercial Cells (39 Storage Conditions)
datasets.duration_note: 496-770 days across conditions; described as about two years on average.
datasets.grain: 117 physical cells, 39 storage conditions, three cells per condition.
datasets.recommended_action: Do not spend 10.3 GB on the LFP confirmation task; retain as a possible cross-chemistry negative control.
